title: 뇌 CT
text:
Brain CT (non-enhanced)
임상: 교통사고 후 두통, 의식 명료.

판독소견:
Intracranial hemorrhage 없음. Midline shift 없음.
Ventricles, sulci 정상. Gray-white differentiation 유지.
Skull fracture 없음. 좌측 frontal scalp hematoma 소량.
Paranasal sinus: 양측 maxillary sinus mucosal thickening, mild.

결론:
1. No acute intracranial abnormality.
2. Lt frontal scalp hematoma.
3. Mild chronic sinusitis 의심.
teaches: A false flag, shown on purpose: MedGemma raises a scalp haematoma on a normal trauma CT.
